plan: Given my value of $35, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while ensuring a win. Assuming others bid near their values, I estimate their bids to average around $24. I will bid $30 to outbid them but still pay less than my value if I win. This strategy balances winning chances and profit margin.

Assuming others bid close to their values, a bid of around $33.5 could outbid those with values slightly below mine while minimizing overpayment if I win. This strategy balances winning probability and potential profit.
